title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Early Termination Charges and Pull-Ahead
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — returning the vehicle before the scheduled window**

**What an early termination is.** An early termination is the lessee's own act of returning the vehicle before the scheduled turn-in window.

**Acceptance.** An early turn-in is accepted only when the lease's payments made count is at least 3 (the figure in every tier).

**Early termination charges.** The early termination charges are:
- the shortfall — the adjusted lease balance less the realized value, never below zero;
- plus the early termination fee for the tier;
- plus the disposition fee;
- plus the past-due amount;
- plus excess mileage and excess wear under the end-of-term rule.

The realized value is the wholesale price the vehicle brings at Kestrel's remarketing auction, net of no expenses.

The former clause that for an early termination the mileage allowance is prorated — the annual mileage allowance divided by 12 times the months elapsed, a partial final month counted as a whole month — is **no longer in force**; the mileage allowance is now set under the current basis.

**Pull-ahead.** A pull-ahead applies only when all three hold: the lease's remaining payments are no more than the tier's pull-ahead maximum; days past due is 0; and the customer has signed a new Kestrel lease, a new-vehicle retail contract or a balloon contract whose lease date or contract date falls within 90 calendar days before the turn-in date. A qualifying pull-ahead is recorded as a scheduled-end turn-in with termination type pull-ahead: the remaining payments are waived, and no shortfall and no early termination fee is charged; mileage is prorated as for an early termination, and wear and disposition follow the end-of-term rule. A tier whose pull-ahead maximum is 0 has no pull-ahead.

| Remaining payments within the tier's maximum | Days past due | New Kestrel lease, new-vehicle retail or balloon contract dated within 90 days before turn-in | Pull-ahead |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 0 | yes | applies |
| yes | 0 | no | does not apply |
| yes | 3 | yes | does not apply |
| no | 0 | yes | does not apply |

**Worked illustration (all figures hypothetical)**: an early turn-in after 20 payments; adjusted lease balance $24000; realized value $21500; the tier's early termination fee taken as $500 for the illustration; disposition fee $395; past-due amount $0. The shortfall is $2500, and the charges before excess mileage and excess wear are $2500 plus $500 plus $395, that is $3395. Had the auction brought $25000, the shortfall would be zero, not a credit.

superseded_clauses: For an early termination the mileage allowance is prorated: annual_mileage_allowance divided by 12 times lease_msr_months_elapsed.
